contract.precondition: self.CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item | i.Barcode = barcode)
contract.postcondition: result = true and OrderEntry.allInstances()->exists(e: OrderEntry | e.oclIsNew() and e.Quantity = quantity and e.Item.Barcode = barcode and e.SubAmount = quantity * e.Item.OrderPrice and self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(e))
